labelChirho: floor, bottom (of a building or container)
descriptionChirho: The floor or bottom surface of a structure, whether a building (temple, house) or a container (ship's hold). All three clusters are inflectional variants of one concrete noun: definite/prepositional 'the floor / from the floor' (eng: the floor, spa: el piso, arb: الأَرْضِيَّةِ, kor: 바닥에서, swa: sakafu), construct 'floor of' (eng: floor-of, spa: piso de, hin: फर्श, arb: أَرْضِيَّةَ, kor: 바닥의), and prepositional beth 'on the floor of' (eng: on the floor of, spa: en suelo de, hin: फर्श पर, arb: في أَرْضِيَّةِ, kor: 에서 바닥, swa: katika sakafu ya). Used in Ezek 41:20, 43:14; 1Ki 6:15-16; Am 9:3; Jonah 1:5.
